name: scholarforge
description: Autonomous scientific publishing: research plans, verified sources, machine-checked mathematics, figures and print-ready books built locally with Quarto and LuaLaTeX.

interface.shortDescription: Write and publish rigorous scientific books
interface.longDescription: ScholarForge turns Codex into a scientific publishing studio: it plans research, verifies every cited work against Crossref, OpenAlex and arXiv, checks formulas with SymPy, renders figures, keeps terminology consistent across chapters and typesets HTML, EPUB, PDF and print-ready PDF locally with Quarto and LuaLaTeX. Book content never leaves your machine.
defaultPrompt: Use ScholarForge to create a rigorous textbook about the mathematical foundations of deep learning.
Use ScholarForge to resume my book project and continue writing.
Use ScholarForge to build the print-ready edition and show me the preflight report.
